info.description: The Adopted Pets Listing API provides a comprehensive view of pets that have been successfully adopted through the system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about adopted pets, including their profiles and adoption details. It is particularly useful for animal shelters, pet adoption agencies, and pet-related organizations seeking to track adoption outcomes. Developers can integrate this API to enhance user experiences by displaying success stories and available data on adopted pets.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of adopted pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access a list of pets that have been adopted. It provides details such as the pet's name, breed, and adoption date, helping users to view the success stories of adopted pets.
